title: Embeddability closure and the absence of dark sectors
html: Because every knot type produced by generation remains embeddable in the genus-4 fiber, all fundamental particles interact. They all descend to the same base manifold and participate in categorical braiding. A hypothetical genus-5 particle would be unobservable and have zero coupling to other particles. The \chi = -6 constraint thus guarantees a self-consistent, fully interacting particle spectrum with no dark sectors.
